items.title: feat: move a conversation that has no project into one (#202306)
items.summary: feat: move a conversation that has no project into one (#202306) * feat(gateway): move a conversation without a project into one moveSessionIntoProject records the project and a pending checkout on a conversation that has neither, the same intent a session created in the project carries. Its next turn opens the checkout through prepareSessionWorkspaceForRun, so setup scripts, ignored files, sandbox and context follow the project open path. A move can name a folder in the conversation's workspace. Its commit starts the new branch, and its unsaved changes are laid over the checkout. Git reads that folder inside the conversation's sandbox, or on the host through the trusted-config view with hooks off, and hands the project one bundle. Earlier messages keep opening the files they named. The idle check moves out of PR adoption into describeSessionWorkspaceBlocker so both callers share it. * fix(gateway): keep a host carry inside the conversation's own Git data A checkout in the conversation's workspace can name Git data elsewhere on the host through a .git file or objects/info/alternates. The host carry then read another repository's commits into the project and wrote objects into it. The carry now requires the checkout's git dir and common dir to resolve inside the workspace, with no alternates, and refuses with nothing moved. * fix(gateway): refuse a host carry whose Git data holds symlinks * feat(agents): let an agent move its own conversation into a project The opt-in session_project tool lists the registered projects the requester may use and moves the conversation into one, optionally bringing a checkout's work along. The move records the project and pending checkout; because the resumed turn is a session event, which never prepares a pending checkout, the tool opens it through prepareSessionWorkspaceForRun before resuming. Conversations with or without a sandbox can move. The tool is built only when tool policy names it, so agents without a tool profile do not gain it. The GitHub publication tool construction moves into a sibling module with it so openclaw-tools.ts stays within its line cap. * refactor(gateway): move the newest core method rows into an appended table core-descriptors.ts is at its line cap, so new core methods could not be added. Its last rows move unchanged into core-descriptors.appended.ts, which the main table spreads at its end, keeping the combined order append-only. The protocol since guard and the protocol-generation scope read both files. * feat(ui): move a conversation without a project into one Adds the projects.moveSessionOptions and projects.moveSession protocol schemas and a "Move to project…" item in the conversation header menu for conversations outside every project and worktree. The dialog lists the projects the conversation can move into, says which local work comes along, and moves it, ending with a toast that names the project and branch. * feat(gateway): let an operator move a conversation without a project into one projects.moveSessionOptions lists the registered projects the operator may use, each with the checkouts in the conversation's workspace whose origin is that project. Git reads them inside the conversation's sandbox, or on the host through the trusted-config view for a conversation without one. projects.moveSession records the move; the person's next message opens the project, as it does for a session created in it, so the dialog's toast says so instead of naming a branch. * fix(gateway): list only checkouts whose Git data is the conversation's own The move dialog's host listing read HEAD, subject and origin through a .git file or alternates that could point at another repository on the host. It now skips any checkout whose git dir or common dir resolves outside the workspace or that borrows objects through alternates. * fix(ci): repair session project move checks * ci: retry Android native validation * fix: offer matching projects to general conversations * perf(ui): defer project move dialog and copy * fix: keep project move within CI guards and boot budget * fix: preview and restore carried project work before setup * fix: keep project moves within lint and chat boot budgets * fix: carry project work from a shared Git ancestor * feat: let agents move into registered projects by default * fix: align project move scope and break session type cycle * fix: preserve successful session project handoffs * fix: resume project moves with current sandbox authority * fix(ui): simplify the project move dialog * refactor(gateway): share workspace transition checks * fix(agents): finish the request after a project move * fix(gateway): reject unsupported sandbox project moves * fix: replay a completed project move as a historical receipt * fix: prepare a conversation checkout before confirming its project move * refactor(gateway): remove deferred project move preparation * fix(gateway): let the session store guard project moves * fix(agents): replay completed project moves as native history --------- Co-authored-by: Codex
